title: DOW-UAP-PR063, "Spherical UAP [CALLSIGN] 2021/04/12 vid 2"
what_is_it: A military infrared and full-motion video recording of a spherical unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) captured by a U.S. military platform in the CENTCOM area of responsibility.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text available — all facts derived from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
The callsign in the video title is redacted, limiting identification of the observing platform.
AARO notes many materials in this collection lack a substantiated chain-of-custody, reducing evidential reliability.
The video was uploaded to a classified network three years after the incident date, introducing a provenance gap.
The described video content (49 seconds of tracking, then pan-away) suggests the observation was brief and the video description appears incomplete (cuts off with 'This video description is').
AARO uses hedging language ('likely derived from'), indicating uncertainty about the sensor source.
Only the first 50 seconds of the 4:49 video are described; the remaining content is uncharacterised.
